title: The Wax Light
author: Barış Kısır
premise: The candle-maker\'s shop on Tanner Lane makes the city\'s finest wax — and its finest lies: the wax seals that close the city\'s letters, contracts, and crimes. When the Master of the Seal dies with an unbroken seal on his own letter, journeyman wax-shaper Benet must prove the seal was made after the letter was written — and find who pressed it.
